title: Live improvement log
summary: Operator-ordered rolling log (2026-08-18): the orchestrator records improvement observations from live supervision over the coming hours. Every entry is reconciled against in-flight cards and existing dossiers before it may propose new work - dedup is the core discipline. Entries carry one of three verdicts: covered-by (existing key), operator-action (no ticket needed, a hand must move), or new-candidate (becomes a card only after a second sighting or operator nod). [Curation 2026-08-21 (AGT-2671): stays current as a standing rolling log, not a single-decision dossier - it has no sourceTaskKeys/slices of its own to deliver, so "every committed slice is delivered" does not apply. The former status "accepted" and phase "in-progress" are outside the descriptor vocabulary (see backend/Features/Docs/WorkbenchCatalogueService.cs AllowedStatuses/AllowedPhases) and made this Dossier render as "Descriptor needs repair"; corrected to active/informational, matching the vocabulary used for the other standing-reference dossiers (nordstern, protokoll-verdichtung, admin-design-guideline). Its own entries already track relatedTaskKeys accurately: AGT-2655 and AGT-2672 delivered, AGT-2648/AGT-2662 still decision-pending with their own dossiers, AGT-2663's cutover investigation resolved with the rollout hold lifted (see index.html's most recent entries), AGT-2658/AGT-2664 still open.]
